verdict: approved for freeze and clean build with specified captured-operand sensitivity model
review: Capture uses existing scoped EOS context at actual mass, interior RDN/gravity and top RDNW consumers; no-throw collectors mark missing, invalid or duplicate; accepted helper checks both endpoint statuses and existing accepted trial input/K/R/context checks remain.

RDN captured CPU FP32 and used indices, actual gravity and top RDNW represented as exact float promoted for JSON; cq1==1 and canonical branch gate, msfty/alpha/velocity/level mass finiteness and positivity; cloned W S_inv block checked CPU FP64 finite positive with start/count.

W pressure uses alpha_w=(c1f*mu_full+c2f)/msfty across packed state, while level_mass_w computed on physical core and extended separately. Extrema alone do not establish pointwise alpha_w*msfty==level_mass_w on aliases; use directed bound based on actual alpha_min*msfty_min, or separately prove pointwise equality.

Base/accepted matching of msfty extrema alone does not establish pointwise map equality; existing selected fixed-input Handle/hash checks provide only observed-subset value/owner evidence, not a full-context guarantee.

Calls are compile-time diagnostic gated and no arithmetic formula changed; no extra RHS/JVP, but capture performs allocations, clones and synchronizing reductions, and exceptions fail the diagnostic evidence.
PressureEosContext ABI is enlarged; rebuild all dependent objects using matching headers and compile macros, verify exact link and existing focused checks.
limitations: No code edit, build, test, native or model run by reviewer.
